course.tagline: Live crypto, stock and markets research and trading calls from Ran Neuner (founder of Crypto Banter) and his team.
course.about: 247 Research is a markets research and trading-calls community founded by Ran Neuner, founder of Crypto Banter. Members get live research meetings, real-time trading calls across crypto, stocks and commodities, the "247 Terminal" news-execution platform, and daily market reports. It's built around live calls and analysis rather than a structured course.
